name: Enigma Filmes
description: Enigma Filmes is a brazilian production company established in Rio de Janeiro since 2003. Our main focus are documentary films and tv series based on social and environmental issues in communities across the globe. Recent works include India, Nepal, Myanmar and Brazil. Through this concept, Enigma Filmes has been working with partners like ARTE, RAI, Globo TV, Canal Brasil, Canal Futura, Petrobrás, Vale do Rio Doce Foundation, Ampla, LC Barreto and many other companies. Enigma Filmes. Illuminating the Human Condition.
